_readme: Golden classification set for `npm run eval`. Labels are the owner's to change; Claude Code must not edit them to make the eval pass. `unambiguous: true` rows must score 100%; the rest count toward the overall >= 90% target. The eval should not send items one at a time. Shuffle with a fixed seed and pack them into synthetic notes of 8-12 blocks, so the model sees realistic surrounding context, then score each item. Keep these items out of FEW_SHOT in lib/ai/prompts.ts. Add rows from real notes over time.
